name: Shikii Mats
description: Shikii Mats is a landing theme for entrance-mat hire serving offices, shops, clinics and showrooms. A fitter lays a clean mat inside the door and swaps it every four weeks from the depot at Unit 4, Canal Yard, Easton. The home page is one long booking page: site cards, the four-week round, trial month and prices, with a single call to book a trial install.
